retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast industrial aesthetic featuring heavy diagonal halftone shading, distressed textures, and bold, blocky typography with integrated symbols.
triggerTerms: bold stencil type with star cutout

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition characterized by a weathered, beige-textured background framed by a messy, ink-splattered border. The central focus is a large, abstract shape rendered in thick, diagonal black halftone lines, flanked by two distinct typographic elements: a bold, slanted sans-serif header with a red 'X' containing a star, and a hand-drawn, irregular block-letter footer.
coreVisualRelationships: Heavy diagonal halftone lines defining the central abstract form
Contrast between the clean, slanted header and the rough, hand-drawn footer
Distressed, splattered border framing the entire composition
Muted beige background providing a neutral base for high-contrast black and red elements
coreInvariants: Diagonal halftone line pattern at approximately 45 degrees
Five-pointed star cutout within a specific letterform

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central halftone shape occupies the middle third; the header dominates the top third; the footer sits in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, slanted header text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold header, follows the diagonal halftone lines downward, and rests on the irregular footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space around the central halftone shape, filled with a weathered, grainy texture.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark black elements and light background; low saturation overall except for the red accent.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, slanted sans-serif and irregular hand-drawn block letters
letterConstructionRules: Header: Extra-bold, italicized, geometric sans-serif with tight kerning
Footer: Irregular, hand-drawn block letters with varying widths and wobbly edges
Integration of a five-pointed star into the cross-section of the 'X'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'X' is rendered in red with a white star cutout at the intersection
The 'I' in the header is composed of two parallel vertical bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between clean, aggressive geometric italics and raw, organic hand-lettering.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and slant for the header.
Captures the industrial, hand-made feel of the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square, weathered beige paper texture with a messy, black ink-splattered border. In the center, place an abstract geometric shape rendered in thick, black diagonal halftone lines at a 45-degree angle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, italicized sans-serif title at the top in black, with the final letter 'X' in red containing a white star cutout. Add a smaller, hand-drawn block-letter word in the bottom right corner in black.

verificationChecks: Is the border distressed and irregular?
Are the halftone lines diagonal and high-contrast?
Does the 'X' contain a star cutout?
Is the background a weathered beige texture?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the halftone lines do not blur into solid shapes.
Ensure the border looks like ink bleed rather than a clean frame.
Verify the star cutout is sharp and centered in the 'X'.
Confirm the beige texture has sufficient grit and variation.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Halftone + Distressed Border + Bold Italic Header + Hand-drawn Footer + Muted Tri-color Palette
